title: [task] characterization test for replyDustManifestKey
body:
add a characterization test for replyDustManifestKey in src/intraday-reply-dust.ts: manifest key per session
- replyDustManifestKey("2026-01-05") is "permanent/intraday-reply-dust/2026-01-05/manifest.json"
- replyDustManifestKey("bad") throws INVALID_SESSION_DATE
